reason: The claimed uniform amplification is not supplied by this node's allowed inputs. compressed-product-display gives the O(e) comparison for a compressed corner at level one. def-hcb-datum merely packages an extended ambient algebra, compressed corners, and amplified column spaces, and expressly supplies data/notation rather than estimates; it does not identify M_n tensor S_P with the corner S_{I_n tensor P}, nor identify the amplified dot product/compression with the level-n compressed product. Those are nontrivial amplification/naturality facts (indeed the repository has separate validated lem-compcb-amplified-compression and lem-compcb-corner-algebra contracts), but neither is an allowed dependency here. Consequently one cannot apply compressed-product-display uniformly to Z in M_n tensor S_P, so the asserted dimension-free K_dot bound is a hidden unsupported assumption. Exact isometry of dagger in each ambient M_n tensor A does not repair the missing compressed-corner amplification step.
